evidence_span.text: aldehyde dehydrogenase 1A1 (ALDH1A1, alternatively known as retinaldehyde dehydrogenase 1 or RALDH1), have also been identified as being associated with metabolic disease

reviews.rationale: This model-assessed finding links ALDH1A1/RALDH1 to vitamin A metabolism and metabolic disease, with the review's scope including NAFLD/NASH. It provides secondary, incomplete support for the broader aldehyde-oxidation claim.

evidence_span.text: HAOX2 is expressed predominantly in liver and kidney and displays highest activity toward 2-hydroxypalmitate.

reviews.rationale: This model-assessed gene-specific enzyme activity supports HAO2 oxidation of a 2-hydroxy fatty acid. The human biochemical system is indirect for aging/MASLD mouse hepatocytes.

evidence_span.text: FIT1 and a FIT2 partial loss-of-function mutant, N80A, had significantly lower triolein binding and produced smaller LDs.

reviews.rationale: This model-assessed gene-specific result links FIT1 triglyceride binding to lipid-droplet formation. The biochemical and ectopic mouse-liver evidence is close to, but not directly within, aging/MASLD hepatocytes.

evidence_span.text: The LD number in the siPSMD1, siPSMD2, and siPSMD1 + siPSMD2 cell groups was significantly less than the number of control group cells (p < 0.05, Fig. 3b).

reviews.rationale: This model-assessed perturbation result supports PSMD1 as a positive regulator of cellular lipid-droplet accumulation. HepG2/Huh7 carcinoma cells are an indirect context for aging/MASLD mouse hepatocytes.
